Our Mission

We promise that no child without a home will go to sleep cold — by giving every one of them a soft, warm blanket that’s all their own. For a child living in a car, a shelter, or a motel room, a blanket is comfort on a scary night and a reminder that somebody cares.

Our Promise to Kids

Every child gets a fresh blanket that’s theirs to keep — never a hand-me-down.

Brand-new, always

Kid-sized, cuddly, and covered in cheerful colors children love.

Made for little ones

We partner with family shelters, schools, and outreach teams who know the kids who need us.

Delivered with care

A blanket is more than warmth.

It will be your cape when you’re brave, and a hug when you’re not.

Who We Help

Little hearts, big needs.

Our blankets go to children and young people without a stable home — wherever they’re spending the night.

Babies and toddlers

Our tiniest neighbors, who need extra warmth to rest and grow.

Young kids

Children moving between shelters, cars, and motels who need something steady to hold.

Teens

Young people facing homelessness on their own or with family, often unnoticed.

Siblings together

So every brother and sister in the family gets a blanket of their very own.

Whole families

Parents and kids in transition, staying warm together while they get back on their feet.

Kids in crisis

Children displaced by fire, flood, or sudden loss of housing who need comfort right away.

cozy & loved

About Us

It started with one blanket and one little smile.

The Cozy Promise was founded in 2026 by Savana Southern in Houston, Texas, after learning how many children in our own community were going to sleep without a warm blanket.

Today we’re a growing family of donors, volunteers, and partners. We buy new, kid-friendly blankets in bulk to make every dollar go further, and deliver them through family shelters, schools, and outreach teams.

Founded 2026 Based in Houston, TX
